old_caption: The video begins with a white mug on a plain white surface. A clear plastic bottle pours water into the mug from the right. After pouring stops, the camera slowly moves closer to the mug, focusing on its contents. Inside, a single red object rests at the bottom.
original_wisa_caption: The video begins with a close-up shot of a white mug placed on a plain white surface. A hand holding a clear plastic bottle pours water into the mug from the right side of the frame. The water flows smoothly, filling the mug gradually. Once the mug is filled to about half its capacity, the hand stops pouring. The scene then transitions to a different mug, which is also white but has a slightly different shape and handle design. This new mug is shown from a top-down perspective, highlighting its interior. Inside the mug, there is a single red object, possibly a coin or a small round item, floating at the bottom. The camera remains stationary throughout these shots, focusing on the mugs and their contents without any additional elements or background distractions.
caption: A white ceramic mug with a left handle rests on a plain surface, holding clear water and a small red disc at the bottom. At the start a transparent bottle tilts over the rim, then lifts toward the upper right, revealing a hand and a thin falling stream. After the bottle leaves, the red object stays at the bottom while a white bubbly patch forms on its top and shifts. It moves from one edge to the top and then left as the wide shot holds. Gradually the framing tightens, the mug filling the image and its handle drifting partly beyond the left edge. The red object grows larger without moving, indicating a camera approach rather than object motion. The water surface reads as a faint ellipse in close-up, and the patch fades from sight. Within the tight view, the red disc remains centered at the bottom, still submerged.
